content: Debt simplification (Splitwise 'Simplify Debts') recalculates net balances into a minimal set of payments so people who don't owe each other directly can settle in fewer transactions. It never changes anyone's total net balance, only the payment graph. Full optimal minimization is NP-complete (related to subset-sum); production implementations use greedy heuristics (repeatedly match largest creditor with largest debtor) which run fast and are near-optimal, not necessarily perfectly optimal. This is an OPTIONAL enhancement on top of raw balance tracking, not required for correctness.
